scoped_claim: In a deliberately coordinate-aligned synthetic two-layer MoE regression task, tied experts plus layer-specific Givens views passed the 3/3 quality/storage screen and beat byte-near gate/rank-1 controls; current CPU implementation was slower.
notes: 46.8% fewer serialized bytes than untied; median inference throughput 0.61x ordinary tying. Teacher is intentionally Mirror-aligned; natural-LM generality and optimized kernels untested.

scoped_claim: The tested final-layer Givens view preserved all prompt K/V caches, but did not replace independent rank-2 domain LoRA updates on three synthetic fresh worlds; a rank-1 private residual improved quality but did not close the gap.
notes: 28.1% fewer bytes than DMoE rank-2 LoRA, but MSE ~0.016 vs 3.6e-14–6.1e-14. Final-layer K/V delta=0; early-view downstream K/V delta=0.3494. Synthetic linear task, domain address supplied.

scoped_claim: With a teacher deliberately generated from shared projection plus Givens role/head transforms, Mirror recovered attention output and used half the MQA cache bytes; strict model-payload reduction versus MQA missed its 20% gate.
notes: Serialized payload 2,100B vs MQA 2,349B (-10.6%) and MHA 3,885B. Cache 128B vs 256B/1,024B. Gate control matched bytes but had much higher MSE. Small synthetic CPU screen; runtime slower.

scoped_claim: On a deliberately shared-base/layer-rotation attention teacher with identical memory states per layer, Mirror layer views reproduced output and halved physical cache bytes versus MLKV-2; actual model-payload byte reduction missed its threshold.
notes: Cache 256B vs 512B MLKV-2; payload 2,541B vs 2,864B (-11.3% vs prereg -25%). Same memory input at each layer; eager CPU runtime regressed.

scoped_claim: On one deliberately Givens-aligned synthetic recurrent-depth task, the per-step Mirror variant failed the 1,200-update development screen: selected-LR MSE was worse than tied, scalar-gate, and static rank-1 LoRA controls, despite using fewer bytes than untied blocks.
notes: Development only, fresh worlds not opened under preregistered failure gate; exact payload replay and 12/12 metric replay passed. No capacity or language claim.

scoped_claim: On the synthetic P=4 correlated-branch task, Givens packet views reached >=99% fresh exact-packet accuracy in 2/3 worlds but collapsed to 26.5% in one; broadcast shared-code control reached 100% in 3/3 while using 378 fewer serialized model bytes. Mirror used the same address entropy as PTP. Independent-mode quality was low across all controls and did not establish an entropy boundary.
notes: Fresh seeds 24801-24803; 36/36 result replayed, exact payload-byte match, max NLL replay delta 4.62e-10. Synthetic fixed-budget screen only.

scoped_claim: With a deliberately Givens-aligned synthetic four-offset teacher, one shared output head plus offset Mirror views matched ordinary MTP top-1 distributions in 3/3 fresh worlds using 4,384B vs 6,497B (-32.5%). On independent offset matrices, Mirror fell to 37.6-38.6% top-1 while rank-1 residual improved to 40.4-43.2%; ordinary MTP remained exact.
notes: Current CPU inference throughput 0.42x MTP and training wall +34%; synthetic frozen-feature mechanism only; language and optimized kernels untested.

scoped_claim: On a deliberately Givens-aligned synthetic 4-role linear expert task, one shared matrix plus learned per-role Mirror views matched untied quality in 3/3 fresh worlds with 3,406B vs 5,522B (-38.3%). notes: 48/48 fresh rows replayed; exact payload bytes. VSA codes fixed and deterministic from charged seed/algorithm; synthetic linear mechanism only.

scoped_claim: For a teacher whose expert and depth transformations factor across separate hidden subspaces, factorized Mirror matched untied quality in 3/3 fresh worlds with 3,608B vs 15,317B untied (-76.4%) and 3,803B Cartesian per-pair coordinates (-5.1%). Independent pair matrices defeated both factorized and Cartesian views; untied remained exact.
notes: 54/54 fresh rows replayed with exact payloads. Fixed 4x4 synthetic linear task; combination count is not independent capacity; CPU throughput regressed.

notes: 36 fresh rows replayed with exact bytes; 4 tests pass. Fixed 1,200-update CPU screen; one aligned MSE gate miss, runtime slower than full MoE; near-convergence and natural-LM claims untested.

notes: 30/30 fresh rows replayed with exact bytes. Current eager CPU implementation had +7.8% compute proxy, median throughput 0.085x full MoE. Deliberately aligned synthetic teacher; capacity/language claims untested.

notes: Fresh worlds 90001–90003; 30/30 replayed, exact bytes, max natural MSE delta 4.7e-10. CPU inference ~0.061x full MoE. Fixed-budget linear screen; small absolute quality differences may reflect rare-role optimization variation.
